component.name: CardHorizontal
component.description: A horizontal course card (thumbnail-left layout) with an 80×80px square thumbnail and a content column: the title and optional ProgressBar (stack xs), then a metadata row (Inline gap sm) at stack sm. The metadata row renders author · duration (a 4px separator dot only between those two, drawn by the component) and the certified badge (no separator; its icon already sets it apart). Two usages: started courses (default variant, progress, duration, optional certified) and footer promotion (inverted variant, author, duration). For vertical image-top course cards use CardVertical; for generic surface containers use Card.

useWhen: Listing started or saved courses in the User Settings page
Displaying course recommendations in a footer or sidebar with an inverted dark background

notFor.case: Using CardHorizontal for non-course content (e.g., user profile, article)
notFor.because: The fixed 80×80 thumbnail and metadata row are designed for course items.
notFor.note: Use Card with a custom inner layout for other content types.

notFor.case: Passing long course titles and expecting them to wrap
notFor.because: The title is a single line with an ellipsis. Sighted users lose the truncated text (screen readers still get the full title), and the risk grows at 200% zoom.
notFor.note: Keep titles short enough to fit the list width. Use CardVertical when titles are long.

patterns.name: started-courses-list
patterns.description: Courses the learner has started: a vertical Stack of CardHorizontal items with progress, duration and optional certified. No author.
patterns.tree: Stack(gap=sm) > [CardHorizontal(title, progress=65, duration, certified), CardHorizontal(title, progress=20, duration), ...]

patterns.name: footer-recommendations
patterns.description: Promotional, not-started items in the dark footer: inverted variant with author and duration, no progress. The Box provides the inverted background color; no theme switch is needed — both parent and cards stay in the light theme.

patterns.name: certified-badge
patterns.description: The Icon+Text 'Certified' badge in the metadata row is not exclusive to this component's internal layout — reuse the same composition wherever a certified badge appears outside a Card (e.g. a page's course-detail metadata row). Icon gets its color from a `.badge svg { color: var(--ds-color-icon-subtle); }` rule in a co-located CSS Module, targeting the ancestor per the Icon color rule (packages/components/AGENTS.md) — never an inline `style={{ color }}` on the wrapping element. On an inverted surface, override it with color.icon.inverted.default.

useWhen.default: Standard light-theme context. Text uses default and subtle color tokens.
useWhen.inverted: Inverted-background context within the light theme (e.g. the dark footer section). Switches the title to Heading color=inverted, metadata to Text color=inverted-subtle, and the badge icon to color.icon.inverted.default. The parent container must supply the dark background via color.background.container.inverted — do NOT use data-theme='dark'. Figma: Variant=inverted.

rules.case: Placing CardHorizontal in a section whose heading is not an h2 (e.g. directly under the page h1, or inside an h3 subsection)
rules.because: The title always renders as an h3 (there is no heading-level prop), so any parent heading other than h2 skips or inverts a level in the document outline.
rules.do: Put CardHorizontal lists inside a section headed by an h2. If a layout needs another level, raise it as a component change (a titleAs prop) instead of wrapping or restyling the card.
